info.title: WebKit - Email Validator, Link Preview & Article Extractor
info.description:
# WebKit: Email Validator, Link Preview and Article Extractor

Three everyday web utilities behind one key: validate email addresses (syntax, MX, disposable, role and typo detection), turn any URL into a rich link preview, and extract the readable article from a page as clean text and Markdown.

**Who it's for:** developers building signup forms, CRMs, chat apps, CMSs, newsletters and AI/LLM pipelines that need clean web content.

## Use cases
- Block disposable and mistyped emails at signup, and suggest `jane@gmail.com` for `jane@gmial.com`.
- Clean a marketing list before a send to protect sender reputation.
- Render Slack-style link cards in a chat or social app.
- Pull article text from URLs for summarisation, RAG ingestion or read-later apps.
- Enrich CRM leads with the website title and description.

## Quickstart
Subscribe on RapidAPI (a free plan is available), copy your key, then:

```bash
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://webkit-email-validator-link-preview-article-extractor.p.rapidapi.com/email/validate?email=jane%40gmial.com' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Key: YOUR_RAPIDAPI_KEY' \
  --header 'X-RapidAPI-Host: webkit-email-validator-link-preview-article-extractor.p.rapidapi.com'
```

## Authentication
Every request goes through RapidAPI. Send `X-RapidAPI-Key` (your key) and `X-RapidAPI-Host` (`webkit-email-validator-link-preview-article-extractor.p.rapidapi.com`) on every call. Requests that bypass the gateway are rejected with `403`.

## Good to know
- Email checks are DNS-based: the API never connects to the mail server or sends mail, so `deliverable` means 'very likely deliverable', not a mailbox guarantee.
- URL endpoints fetch pages live with a 10 second timeout and read at most 3 MB. JavaScript is not executed, so content rendered client-side may be missing.
- Only public http(s) URLs are allowed; private and reserved IP ranges are blocked.

## Rate limits and plans
Request quotas and per-second limits depend on the RapidAPI plan you subscribe to; see the Pricing tab. When a limit is reached the gateway returns `429 Too Many Requests`; retry with exponential backoff or move to a higher plan.

## Errors
All errors are JSON. The API returns `{"error": "<reason>"}` with a meaningful HTTP status: `400` disallowed URL (not http/https, or a private address), `415` fetched URL is not HTML, `422` missing or invalid parameter, `502` upstream site or service failed. Gateway errors (`401`/`403`/`429`) come from RapidAPI as `{"message": "<reason>"}`.

## Data sources and licences
- Live DNS lookups for MX and A records.
- Built-in, curated lists of disposable domains, role mailboxes, free providers and common typos.
- Page content is fetched from the URL you supply; you are responsible for respecting the target site's terms.

## MCP (AI agents)
This API is also available as a Model Context Protocol server at `POST /mcp` on the same RapidAPI host; see the MCP endpoint for setup.

get.description: Checks syntax, looks up the domain's mail servers (MX, with A-record fallback), and flags disposable domains, role accounts, free providers and common domain typos. Returns a verdict, a 0-100 score and a `did_you_mean` suggestion. No email is sent and no SMTP probe is made, so it is fast and safe for signup forms.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email address to check. Max 254 characters. Remember to URL-encode `+` as `%2B`.

get.summary: Get a link preview for a URL
get.description:
Fetches a page and returns the metadata a chat app or CMS needs to render a rich link card: title, description, image, site name, type, favicon, language and canonical URL. Open Graph tags win, then Twitter Card tags, then plain HTML.

The page is fetched live (10 s timeout, first 3 MB read). Errors: `400` non-http(s) or private address, `415` not an HTML page, `422` missing URL or host does not resolve, `502` fetch failed or the site returned HTTP 4xx/5xx.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public page URL to fetch, starting with http:// or https://. Max 2048 characters. Up to 5 redirects are followed; private, loopback and reserved addresses are refused.

example.description: Join the world's most widely adopted, AI-powered developer platform where millions of developers, businesses, and the largest open source community build software that advances humanity.
example.title: GitHub · Change is constant. GitHub keeps you ahead. · GitHub

get.description:
Fetches a page, removes navigation, headers, footers, scripts, forms, tables and figures, picks the largest <article>/<main> block, and returns clean text plus Markdown with title, author and publish date. Ideal for reading modes, summarisation and feeding LLMs.

The page is fetched live (10 s timeout, first 3 MB read). Errors: `400` non-http(s) or private address, `415` not an HTML page, `422` missing URL or host does not resolve, `502` fetch failed or the site returned HTTP 4xx/5xx.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Public page URL to fetch, starting with http:// or https://. Max 2048 characters. Up to 5 redirects are followed; private, loopback and reserved addresses are refused.

parameters.name: max_chars
parameters.description: Maximum characters returned in `text` and in `markdown`. Values outside 500-100000 are clamped.

Error.description: Error body. Errors raised by the API itself carry an `error` string. Errors raised by the RapidAPI gateway (missing or invalid key, not subscribed, quota or rate limit exceeded) carry a `message` string instead.

email.description: The address that was checked, trimmed.

verdict.description: Overall verdict. `deliverable`: syntax OK, mail server found, not disposable or role, score >= 90. `risky`: passes basics but is a role account or a likely typo of a major provider. `disposable`: throwaway inbox provider. `invalid`: bad syntax or the domain has no mail server.

score.description: Confidence score 0-100: +40 valid syntax, +40 mail server found, +10 not disposable, +10 not a role account, -30 if the domain is a known typo. 0 when syntax is invalid.

syntax.description: Address matches RFC 5322-style syntax (local part up to 64 chars, no consecutive dots).

mx_found.description: Domain has MX records, or an A record that can accept mail as a fallback.

disposable.description: Domain is on the built-in list of disposable or temporary email providers.

role_account.description: Local part is a role mailbox such as info, admin, support, sales or noreply.

free_provider.description: Domain is a free consumer mailbox provider such as gmail.com, outlook.com or yahoo.com.

mx_records.description: Up to 5 mail server hostnames, lowest MX preference first. Contains the domain itself when only an A record exists.

did_you_mean.description: Suggested correction when the domain is a common typo (for example gmial.com), otherwise null.

LinkPreview.description: Link preview metadata (Open Graph, Twitter Card and HTML fallbacks).

status_code.description: HTTP status of the final response.

title.description: og:title, then twitter:title, then the HTML <title>.

description.description: og:description, then twitter:description, then meta description.

image.description: Absolute URL of og:image or twitter:image.

type.description: og:type, for example website or article.

favicon.description: Absolute favicon URL from <link rel=icon>, falling back to /favicon.ico.

canonical.description: Value of <link rel=canonical>, as written in the page.

Article.description: Main article content extracted from the page.

status_code.description: HTTP status of the final response.

published.description: article:published_time or meta date, as written in the page.

text.description: Plain text of headings, paragraphs, list items, quotes and code blocks, separated by blank lines, cut to `max_chars`.

markdown.description: The same content as Markdown (# headings, - lists, > quotes), cut to `max_chars`.

BadRequest.description: Bad request: the URL is not http(s), or points to a private, loopback or reserved address.

example.error: Private or reserved addresses are not allowed

Forbidden.description: Forbidden: the request did not arrive through the RapidAPI gateway, or your RapidAPI key is not subscribed to this API.

example.message: You are not subscribed to this API.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: Unsupported media type: the fetched URL is not an HTML page.

example.error: URL is not an HTML page

ValidationError.description: Unprocessable: a required parameter is missing or a value is invalid. The `error` text says which.

example.error: A required parameter is missing or invalid

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests: your RapidAPI plan's rate limit or monthly quota was exceeded. Back off and retry, or upgrade your plan.

example.message: You have exceeded the rate limit per second for your plan, BASIC, by the API provider

BadGateway.description: Bad gateway: the remote site or upstream service could not be reached, timed out, or returned an error.
